stem: Although pleased to gain recognition by the Royal Society in 1945, Marjory Stephenson privately _______ the way career scientists (always male) jockeyed for recognition and reputation rather than simply getting on with their work.
translation: 虽然玛乔丽·史蒂芬森对1945年获得英国皇家学会的认可感到高兴，但她私下里却对职业科学家（清一色为男性）汲汲于争夺认可与声誉而不是专心做好工作的做派感到不满和痛惜。

stem: Although some literary scholars may express disdain for works meant for popular audiences, only the most _______ proponent of so-called great literature could dismiss the works in a recent anthology of African science fiction as formulaic pulp.
translation: 尽管一些文学学者可能会对面向大众读者的作品表示不屑，但只有最食古不化的所谓严肃文学拥护者，才会将最近出版的一部非洲科幻小说选集中的作品斥为套路化的地摊读物。

stem: Even though no other urban center on Earth thrived for so long, the ancient Mesopotamian city of Uruk remains _______ in comparison with its more famous neighbor, Babylon.
translation: 尽管地球上没有其他任何城市中心能够繁荣如此之久，但与更为著名的邻城巴比伦相比，美索不达米亚古城乌鲁克仍然显得鲜为人知。

stem: Fungi are a basic component of every ecosystem, and their importance cannot be _______, but mycologists generally lack an understanding of which fungi are present in oceans and what roles they play.
translation: 真菌是每个生态系统的基本组成部分，其重要性不容否认，但真菌学家普遍缺乏对海洋中存在哪些真菌以及它们发挥何种作用的了解。

stem: Physicians today increasingly rely on endoscopic surgery, replacing large scalpels and clamps with cameras and with tools whose _______ enables them to snake into the body through tiny holes.
translation: 如今的医生越来越依赖内窥镜手术，用摄像头以及凭借极佳柔韧性能够通过微小孔洞蜿蜒进入体内的工具取代了大手术刀和夹钳。

stem: The airline might receive fewer complaints if it got passengers to their destinations on time: in the past few years, only one airline has been more _______.
translation: 如果该航空公司能够准时将乘客送达目的地，收到的投诉可能会更少：在过去几年里，只有一家航空公司比它更加拖拉延误。

stem: Debates over technologies often _______ their development: we can reflect on many of the social and ethical issues that the possibility of geoengineering the climate raises right as these technologies are coming into existence.
translation: 关于技术的争论往往早于技术本身的发展：当通过地球工程改造气候的可能性随着这些技术的诞生而出现时，我们已经可以反思它所引发的诸多社会和伦理问题。

stem: Laboratory experiments testing whether memories can be purposely erased or implanted seem decidedly _______ compared to the sensational depictions of memory manipulation in movies, but such research has nevertheless yielded dramatic results.
translation: 与电影中对记忆操控的耸人听闻的描绘相比，测试记忆能否被故意消除或植入的实验室实验显得极为平淡无奇，但这项研究依然取得了引人注目的成果。

stem: Scholars of the civil rights movement have often characterized it as springing from social, political, and economic structures _______ the South, thus overlooking the tradition of civil rights activism in other regions of the country.
translation: 民权运动学者常常将该运动定性为源自美国南部特有的社会、政治和经济结构，从而忽视了该国其他地区的民权运动传统。

stem: The fact that no single Cantonese dictionary is seen as _______ is one of the main reasons why most Hong Kong authors do not depend on formal reference tools when writing in Cantonese.
translation: 没有任何一本单独的粤语词典被视作权威词典，这是大多数香港作家用粤语写作时不依赖正规参考工具书的主要原因之一。

stem: Song, speech, and music are typically one in the blues: the instrument complements the voice, and though they may play instrumental solos, the most _______ blues artists sing through both voice and instrument.
translation: 在蓝调音乐中，歌唱、言语和器乐通常融为一体：乐器与人声相辅相成；尽管他们可能会进行器乐独奏，但最具代表性的蓝调艺术家会同时通过嗓音和乐器来进行歌唱。

stem: While the co-authors of the new guide to the American artistic experience have received accolades for their wide-ranging work, they do not _______ that the publication is exhaustive in content.
translation: 尽管这本美国艺术体验新指南的合著者们因其涵盖广泛的研究而备受赞誉，但他们并不坚称该出版物在内容上是面面俱到的。

stem: Among some demographic groups, the Internet is _______: almost everybody who wants Internet access has it.
translation: 在某些人口群体中，互联网是无处不在的：几乎每个想要上网的人都能接入互联网。

stem: There are several strange _______ in the book India: for instance, though subtitled An Intimate Biography of 1.2 Billion People, it finds no place for the nearly 800 million Indians who depend on agriculture for a living.
translation: 《印度》一书中存在几处奇怪的遗漏：例如，虽然副标题是“12亿人的亲密传记”，书中却没有给近8亿依靠农业为生的印度人留出任何篇幅。

stem: Journal editors note that the peer review process has difficulty detecting _______: deliberate misinformation, if it is clever enough, might sail right through no matter how scrupulous the reviews.
translation: 期刊编辑指出，同行评审过程很难发现学术欺诈行为：蓄意伪造的虚假信息只要足够巧妙，无论评审多么细致，都可能一路畅通无阻地过关。

stem: The rebellion was _______ one, driven less by ardor than by reason and calculation.
translation: 这场叛乱是一场理智而冷静的叛乱，驱动它的与其说是热情，不如说是理性和算计。

stem: A fixed definition of the Arctic Circle is _______: the circle is not unchanging but varies over about 2° during 40,000-year cycles caused by wobbles in the angle of the Earth’s axis.
translation: 对北极圈给出一个固定的定义是具有误导性的：北极圈并非一成不变，而是由于地轴倾角摆动，在4万年的周期内产生约2度的变化。

stem: Meteorology is one of the few fields of applied science that demands prediction; since prediction involves considerable uncertainty and uncertainty is _______ scientists, meteorology will continue to exist in a fraught intellectual space.
translation: 气象学是少数需要进行预测的应用科学领域之一；由于预测包含相当大的不确定性，而不确定性又是科学家们深恶痛绝的，因此气象学将继续存在于一个充满紧张与矛盾的学术空间之中。

stem: Throughout human history, intelligence and consciousness have been _______ concepts: those possessing much of the former are assumed, in some ill-defined way, to be more conscious than those less astute.
translation: 纵观人类历史，智力与意识一直是紧密联系的概念：拥有较高智力的人，在某种含糊不清的意义上被理所当然地认为比那些不那么敏锐的人拥有更强的意识。

stem: As a muralist, John Thomas Biggers followed his own voice; absorbed by personal artistic challenges, he devoted _______ attention to prevailing trends in the art world.
translation: 作为一名壁画画家，约翰·托马斯·比格斯遵循着自己的内心之声；他专注于个人的艺术挑战，对艺术界盛行的潮流几乎不屑一顾。

stem: Asteroids of diameter less than 100 km never melted, but asteroids with larger diameters did so and became _______ with the heavier Fe-Ni material forming the core and the silicates forming the crust.
translation: 直径小于100公里的小行星从未熔化，但直径更大的小行星发生过熔化并形成分层结构，较重的铁镍物质构成了核心，硅酸盐则构成了外壳。

stem: The folktale is perhaps the most _______ form of literature: a story that everyone is free to tell and embellish because it belongs to no one in particular.
translation: 民间故事也许是最大众和平等的一种文学形式：每个人都可以自由地讲述和润色这个故事，因为它并不专门属于任何特定的人。

stem: The scholars’ hypothesis challenges the scope of human psychological and behavioral universals but does not dispense with them entirely: the team remains confident that displays of pride, for instance, are _______.
translation: 学者们的假说挑战了人类心理和行为普遍性的适用范围，但并未完全摒弃它们：该团队仍然确信，例如展现骄傲的行为是普遍存在的。

stem: In literature, thrillers thrive on heroes and villains, and usually the characterization is not very _______; writers don’t want to confuse or slow the plot.
translation: 在文学中，惊悚小说依赖于塑造英雄与反派，而且人物刻画通常并不十分细腻微妙；作者不希望让情节变得扑朔迷离或拖沓冗长。

stem: Too much focus on what might have been can cause in us feelings of powerlessness and regret, but some scientists are beginning to think that imagining an alternative reality might have _______ effects as well.
translation: 过度关注“本可能发生的事”会让我们产生无力感和后悔，但一些科学家开始认为，设想另一种可能的生活现实也可能产生有益身心和恢复活力的效果。

stem: According to Panamanian composer Danilo Perez, the gravity of jazz pianist Randy Weston’s performances is _______: you can copy one of his chords, but it doesn’t sound the same.
translation: 据巴拿马作曲家达尼洛·佩雷斯所言，爵士钢琴家兰迪·韦斯顿演奏中的那种庄重深沉是难以企及的：你可以模仿他的一个和弦，但听起来绝不是同一个味道。

stem: Although, in spirit at least, solar panels _______ nature and the way our biosphere harnesses the energy of our sun, the actual photosynthetic process by which plants convert sunlight into chemical energy is far more complex than solar power generation is.
translation: 虽然太阳能电池板至少在精神上模仿了大自然以及生物圈利用太阳能的方式，但植物将阳光转化为化学能的实际光合作用过程，远比太阳能发电要复杂得多。

stem: Because the influence of French women writers in seventeenth-century England has been _______ by scholars, England’s early women writers, such as Aphra Behn and Delarivier Manley, may appear to have sprung from a vacuum.
translation: 由于17世纪法国女性作家对英国的影响被学者们忽视和低估，阿芙拉·贝恩和德拉里维尔·曼利等英国早期女性作家似乎成了无源之水。

stem: While the rate at which absolute global sea level is rising may seem _______, it has been far from an incidental factor in human history.
translation: 虽然全球绝对海平面的上升速率看似微不足道，但在人类历史上，它绝非一个无足轻重的因素。

stem: Faced with so much conflicting information on the internet, many people come to believe that all sources are so _______ that efforts to discriminate between the true and the false are inevitably futile.
translation: 面对互联网上如此多相互矛盾的信息，许多人开始认为所有来源都带有极大的偏见，以至于试图分辨真假不可避免地变得徒劳无功。

stem: A single, cheap tablet combining a range of drugs that protect against heart disease was _______ years ago, but pharmaceutical companies were reluctant to undertake the project because it failed to provide sufficient financial incentive.
translation: 多年前就有人提出研制一种结合多种预防心脏病药物的廉价单片复合制剂，但制药公司因其无法提供足够的经济回报而不愿开展该项目。

stem: The auditors are relying on the failing bank to make changes that it has steadfastly resisted for years and even now does not seem _______ to carry out.
translation: 审计人员正指望这家濒临倒闭的银行做出多年来一直坚决抵制、且即便到了现在似乎仍不情愿去推行的变革。

stem: The vast majority of universities in the United States promote themselves as institutions of free speech and thought, construing censorship as _______ their search for knowledge.
translation: 美国绝大多数大学都将自己宣传为言论和思想自由的殿堂，认为审查制度与它们对知识的追求是格格不入的。

stem: We might be much closer to building the next generation of observatories if competing groups of astronomers had not _______ repeated chances to collaborate; instead, three separate projects with common goals are fighting one another for funding.
translation: 如果相互竞争的天文学家群体当初没有断然拒绝一次又一次的合作机会，我们现在可能距离建造下一代天文台要近得多；相反，三个目标相同的独立项目如今却在为争夺资金而互相争斗。

stem: While the environmental detection of nuclear explosions has become _______, the ability to detect nuclear weapons programs well before they result in a nuclear device would better serve security objectives.
translation: 虽然对核爆炸的环境探测已经变得轻而易举，但在核武器研发项目制造出核装置之前很久就能对其进行探测的能力，才更能契合安全目标。

stem: Most farmers alternate corn and soybean crops in their fields rather than periodically leaving fields unplanted, as was once customary, but such _______ cropping can deplete the organic content of the soil.
translation: 大多数农民在田地里轮作玉米和大豆，而不是像过去那样定期让土地休耕，但这种连绵不断的种植方式会耗尽土壤中的有机质含量。

stem: The ear is much more _______ than the eye: only the ear can tell a source that oscillates 30 times a second from one that oscillates 60 times a second.
translation: 耳朵比眼睛要敏锐得多：只有耳朵才能区分出每秒振动30次的声源与每秒振动60次的声源。

stem: Neurologists are scanning the activity that music triggers in our neurons, but far from generating _______ the neurophysiological function of music, these data are inspiring a pitched debate among researchers.
translation: 神经学家正在扫描音乐在我们神经元中引发的活动，但这些数据非但没有促成关于音乐神经生理功能的共识，反而在研究人员之间激起了一场激烈的争论。

stem: Perhaps the scariest thing about weather extremes is their inherent _______: just because we are almost certain they will become more frequent does not mean we can pinpoint exactly when and where they will occur.
translation: 极端天气最可怕之处或许在于其固有的不可预测性：仅仅因为我们几乎可以肯定它们会变得更加频繁，并不意味着我们能确切指出它们将在何时何地发生。

stem: Family lore has it that jazz saxophonist James Carter’s perfect imitation of birdsong amazed his elementary school classmates, marking him as _______ conjurer of sound.
translation: 家族传说称，爵士萨克斯管演奏家詹姆斯·卡特对鸟鸣声维妙维肖的模仿令他的小学同学惊叹不已，这标志着他自幼就是一位早慧的声音魔法师。

stem: Accounts of early opera performances—both of the performances themselves and of their social milieu—indicate that the origins of the genre were anything but _______; it began at the peak.
translation: 对早期歌剧演出的记载——无论是演出本身还是其社会背景——都表明这一流派的起源绝非卑微平庸；它自诞生之初就处于顶峰。

stem: Although individual dust devils (small whirlwinds) on Mars are _______, collectively they can be counted on to maintain the atmospheric dust at a certain level.
translation: 尽管火星上的单个尘卷风（小型旋风）难以捉摸，但从整体上看，它们能够稳定地将大气中的尘埃维持在一定水平。

stem: Artists such as Jimi Jones reveal how _______ art categories really are: Jones successfully uses materials relatively foreign to the hegemonic concept of fine art while working in a style commonly associated with high culture.
translation: 像吉米·琼斯这样的艺术家揭示了艺术分类实际上是多么人为划定且生硬：琼斯成功使用了与主流纯艺术概念大相径庭的材料，同时又以通常与高雅文化相关的风格进行创作。

stem: While the politician promised that her speech would be full of fresh ideas, all she really offered was _______.
translation: 虽然这位政治家承诺她的演讲将充满新颖的想法，但她实际给出的却全都是陈词滥调。

stem: Conditions at the training camp for runners were _______; few of the runners had proper shoes or a training kit.
translation: 长跑训练营的条件十分简陋艰苦；几乎没有运动员拥有合适的跑鞋或训练装备。

stem: Despite growing evidence of a positive association between consumption of whole grains and long-term health, a research gap exists between observational studies and the elucidation of the mechanisms involved, mechanisms that in some cases are still quite _______.
translation: 尽管越来越多的证据表明食用全谷物与长期健康之间存在正相关关系，但在观察性研究与阐明相关机制之间仍存在研究空白，而在某些情况下，这些机制依然相当模糊不明。

stem: By eating tiny organisms and incorporating their prey’s nutrients into their own bodies, large insects become nutrient packages for larger insectivores for whom the pursuit of tiny organisms would be _______.
translation: 大型昆虫通过捕食微小生物并将猎物的养分转化为自身身体的一部分，从而为更大型的食虫动物提供了现成的营养包，对这些更大型食虫动物来说，直接捕食微小生物在能量获取上是得不偿失的。

stem: Although streams of solar particles cause beautiful auroras—the northern and southern lights—sometimes their consequences are less _______: their electromagnetic effects, for instance, can overload power grids and damage orbiting satellites.
translation: 尽管太阳粒子流会形成美丽的极光（北极光和南极光），但有时它们带来的后果并不那么无害：例如，它们的电磁效应会使电网过载并损坏在轨卫星。

stem: Certainly, the drive to make safety a corporate priority is _______, but whether it will be enough to create the necessary change in corporate culture is another matter; organizational inertia can be a powerful force.
translation: 诚然，将安全作为企业首要任务的举措是明智合理的，但它是否足以在企业文化中带来必要的改变则是另一回事；组织的惰性可能是一股强大的阻力。

stem: In a time when so much new concert music failed to speak to listeners, the composer’s symphonies expressed with _______ wit and scorching emotional power the tragic history he lived through.
translation: 在许多新音乐会作品无法引起听众共鸣的时代，这位作曲家的交响乐以辛辣尖锐的机智和炽烈强烈的情感力量，表达了他所经历的悲剧性历史。

stem: Interest in the recovery of lost works by Brazilian women writers is growing as scholars increasingly recognize writing by Brazilian women as inherently worth study, not as _______ writing by Brazilian men.
translation: 随着学者们越来越认识到巴西女性作家的作品本身就具备研究价值，而不是作为巴西男性作家作品的附属品，人们对发掘巴西女性作家失佚作品的兴趣日益浓厚。

stem: Recent research has shown that memories are not unchanging physical traces in the brain; instead, they are constructs that are _______, rebuilt every time they are recalled.
translation: 最近的研究表明，记忆并不是大脑中一成不变的物理痕迹；相反，它们是具有可塑性的构建体，每次被回忆起时都会被重新构建。

stem: Technology does not have an inherently _______ effect on society; in fact, some technological advances have counteracted social changes that were reducing economic inequality.
translation: 技术对社会并没有内在的平权均等化效应；事实上，某些技术进步反而抵消了原本在减少经济不平等的社会变革。

stem: Tycho Brahe had assigned Kepler the task of deriving parameters for the model of Mars, a particularly _______ problem, which had stymied others because the large eccentricity of Mars exposed the inadequacies of the model itself.
translation: 第谷·布拉赫曾给开普勒布置了为火星轨道模型推导参数的任务，这是一个特别棘手顽固的问题，曾令其他人束手无策，因为火星较大的偏心率暴露了模型本身的缺陷。

stem: The geometry student struggled with the request to demonstrate the _______ proposition, feeling that, since opposite angles were self-evidently equal, there was no need for a proof.
translation: 这位几何学学生对于被要求证明这个显而易见的命题感到困扰，他觉得既然对顶角显然相等，就根本没有必要进行证明。

stem: Because it has usually been impossible to eradicate exotic species once they have become established, it is _______ to minimize introductions of species that have substantial probabilities of unwanted impacts.
translation: 由于外来物种一旦扎根通常就无法被彻底根除，因此尽量减少引入极有可能产生不良影响的物种才是明智审慎之举。

stem: A number of researchers have questioned the long-held assumption that decision making is _______, arguing instead that most behavior is relatively automatic.
translation: 许多研究人员对长期以来认为决策是经过深思熟虑的这一假设提出了质疑，他们转而认为大多数行为都是相对自动化的反应。

stem: Eubank’s efforts to facilitate _______ between the two sides came to nothing but could be seen as an early blueprint for the historic agreement between the sides over ten years later.
translation: 尤班克为促进双方和解所做的努力最终化为泡影，但它可以被视为十多年后双方达成历史性和解协议的早期蓝图。

stem: Many types of rocks contain small voids that _______ vibrations: the greater the proportion of a rock’s volume that is void, the more gradually vibrations travel through it.
translation: 许多类型的岩石都含有能够缓冲震动的微小孔隙：岩石中孔隙所占体积的比例越大，震动在其中传播的速度就越慢。

stem: The landmasses that form our continents are notably _______: they are plates of rock continuously shifting around within the Earth’s crust, in movements that are not just horizontal but also vertical.
translation: 构成我们大陆的陆块显著地处于不断变迁移动的状态：它们是在地壳内不断漂移的岩石板块，其运动不仅是水平方向的，也是垂直方向的。

stem: Deeply self-righteous, the artists defended their new aesthetic principles against a hidebound critical establishment whose mockery only reinforced the artists’ belief in the _______ of traditional aesthetics.
translation: 这些极为自以为是的艺术家在顽固守旧的评论界权威面前捍卫他们的新美学原则，而后者的嘲弄反而更加坚定了这些艺术家关于传统美学已经彻底枯竭破产的信念。

stem: Evidence of the human brain’s _______ abounds: violinists, for example, tend to have larger cortical areas devoted to processing signals from their fingering hands than do non-violinists.
translation: 证明人脑具备可塑性的证据比比皆是：例如，小提琴手大脑中用于处理按弦手信号的皮层区域往往比非小提琴手更大。

stem: The playwright’s political activity on behalf of imprisoned artists finds its artistic analogue in her _______ toward her competitors in the theater, many of them in another kind of exile.
translation: 这位剧作家代表被囚禁艺术家所开展的政治活动，在艺术层面上对应着她对剧场竞争对手的宽宏大量，而这些竞争对手中有许多正处于另一种形式的流亡之中。

stem: Personal computers have become so _______ that the use of digital evidence collected from them is now a common part of many criminal and civil investigations.
translation: 个人电脑已经变得如此普遍无处不在，以至于从中收集的数字证据现已成为许多刑事和民事调查中的常见组成部分。

stem: Recent advances in the study of desert varnish have been a boon to geologists, allowing them to date surface features and establish regional climate histories in _______ detail.
translation: 荒漠岩漆研究的最新进展为地质学家带来了福音，使他们能够以前所未有的详尽程度确定地表特征的年代并重建区域气候历史。

stem: At every turn in her novels, Patricia Highsmith eschews simple distinctions between good and evil, right and wrong, choosing instead to examine how _______ such distinctions can be.
translation: 帕特里夏·海史密斯在小说中处处避开善与恶、对与错之间的简单非黑即白划分，而是选择审视这些界限可以具有何等的可塑与易变。

stem: The proliferation of the zombie in contemporary popular culture is _______: from novels and comic books to video games and performance art, in smartphone applications and in homemade films zombies are ubiquitous.
translation: 丧尸在当代流行文化中的泛滥是显而易见的：从小说、漫画到电子游戏和行为艺术，在智能手机应用和自制电影中，丧尸无处不在。

stem: Smil’s analysis of climate change is even more _______ than that supplied by most well-informed writers, and thus deserves serious consideration.
translation: 斯米尔对气候变化的分析甚至比大多数消息灵通的作家所提供的分析更加细腻深刻而复杂，因此值得予以认真考量。

stem: Many readers are bemused to discover that Ella Wheeler Wilcox’s book Poems of Passion was thought to be _______ when it was published in 1883, as the book seems fairly innocuous.
translation: 许多读者在发现艾拉·惠勒·威尔科克斯的诗集《激情之诗》在1883年出版时曾被认为是有伤风化、骇人听闻的作品时感到困惑不解，因为这本书在今天看来相当温和无害。

stem: When Gustave Flaubert wrote a rabidly depressed letter to his friend George Sand, she responded with a maternal nudge; typical of their correspondence, she liked to pretend that his _______ was an affectation.
translation: 当居斯塔夫·福楼拜给好友乔治·桑写了一封极度沮丧消沉的信时，乔治·桑以母亲般的关切做出了回应；在她与福楼拜的书信往来中，她习惯于将他的绝望苦闷假装看作是一种故作姿态。

stem: Although Wanda Coleman’s sonnets sometimes employ _______ word choices, they aptly bring to the fore a distinctly modern anxiety.
translation: 虽然万达·科尔曼的十四行诗有时会采用陈旧古雅的词汇，但它们恰如其分地凸显出一种鲜明的现代焦虑。

stem: Augustus, the first emperor of Rome, was celebrated for his moderation and temperate living, qualities that would distinguish him from so many of his _______ successors.
translation: 罗马第一任皇帝奥古斯都因其克制与节俭的生活方式而广受赞誉，这些品质使他与随后许多骄奢淫逸的继任者截然不同。

stem: The bird-watchers’ _______ distinguishing personal interpretations from factual observations was a liability in their stated goal of obtaining objective information about the everyday behavior of ravens.
translation: 观鸟者在区分个人主观解读与客观事实观察方面的拙劣能力，成为他们获取乌鸦日常行为客观信息这一既定目标的阻碍。

stem: Although political debates supposedly exist to inform viewers about the candidates’ policy positions, these debates are often _______ by critics who see them as occasions for evasion and posturing.
translation: 尽管政治辩论理应是为了让选民了解候选人的政策立场，但这些辩论往往遭到批评者的抨击与贬低，批评者认为这些辩论不过是政客闪烁其词和摆姿态作秀的场合。

stem: Leaders within the Native American culture known as Fort Ancient differed from those of the neighboring Mississippian groups, whose authority was often _______: indeed, one expert has described the Fort Ancient society as intensely egalitarian.
translation: 被称为“古代堡垒文化”的美洲原住民领袖与邻近密西西比人群体的领袖截然不同，后者的权威往往带有强迫专制的色彩：事实上，一位专家将古代堡垒文化社会描述为高度平等的社会。

stem: Scientists generally agree that causal inferences in well-designed experiments are more reliable than such inferences in purely observational contexts because most uncontrolled variables are _______ in the laboratory environment.
translation: 科学家普遍认为，精心设计的实验中的因果推断比纯粹观察环境中的因果推断更可靠，因为在实验室环境中大多数不受控制的变量都被排除消除了。

stem: To say that John Adams was forthright was to be _______; friends as well as enemies were more likely to characterize his stark honesty and direct manner as blunt and awkward.
translation: 说约翰·亚当斯性格直率已经是相当客气宽容的说法了；无论是朋友还是敌人都更倾向于将他那种毫不掩饰的坦白和直截了当的方式描述为粗鲁生硬与不知变通。

stem: The Chancellor castigated one regime for its mistreatment of political opponents, whereas he inexplicably _______ another that had committed similar acts.
translation: 这位总理严厉斥责了一个政权虐待政敌的行为，却令人费解地为另一个犯下类似罪行的政权开脱罪责。

stem: In order to justify a life spent wandering across some of the world’s farthest corners, travel writer Bruce Chatwin noted that humans are _______ by nature: there seems to be a roaming instinct embedded in our genes.
translation: 为了证明自己在世界一些最偏远的角落流浪的生活是合理的，旅行作家布鲁斯·查特文指出人类天生就具有四处漫游的本性：我们的基因中似乎植入了一种漫游本能。

stem: While Takaezu’s ceramic pieces are highly distinctive, her body of work as a whole can feel _______ to critics who wish to track it since she has never dated or conscientiously documented her creations.
translation: 尽管高江洲敏子（Takaezu）的陶瓷作品极具特色，但对于希望系统梳理其创作脉络的评论家而言，她的整体作品可能会让人感到界限模糊且缺乏系统，因为她从未给自己的创作标明日期或认真记录。

stem: A danger of writing urban history is the temptation to fall into the _______ and then to learn that only a rare few will be interested in reading your overly specialized account of lost times.
translation: 撰写城市历史的一个危险在于容易陷入狭隘的地方主义，随后才发现几乎没有人会有兴趣阅读你对逝去岁月的过度专门化叙述。

stem: Over the past hundred years, numerous experiments on elementary particles have _______ the classical paradigm of a causal, deterministic universe by showing that some natural phenomena are truly random.
translation: 在过去一百年间，大量基本粒子实验通过证明某些自然现象确实是随机的，颠覆了因果决定论宇宙的经典范式。

stem: Concerned to upend the standard top-down approach to game design, Flanagan calls on game designers to _______ the typical model with one that is less hierarchical.
translation: 为了打破标准自上而下的游戏设计方法，弗拉纳根呼吁游戏设计师用一种层级较弱的模式来取代传统模式。

stem: Some species of the genus Daphnia (commonly known as water fleas) are phenotypically _______, altering their diurnal migration behavior and developing exaggerated morphological defenses in response to predators.
translation: 溞属（俗称水蚤）的某些物种在表型上具有可塑性，它们会针对捕食者改变昼夜垂直迁移行为，并发展出夸张的形态防御特征。

stem: Jimi Hendrix was a pivotal figure in the visionary aesthetic movement known as Afrofuturism, which is steeped in African American musical tradition yet _______ technological innovation, from synthesizers to spaceships.
translation: 吉米·亨德里克斯是被称为“非洲未来主义”的前瞻性美学运动的关键人物；该流派深深植根于非裔美国人的音乐传统，却又对从合成器到太空飞船的各种技术创新深感着迷。

stem: While lunar geology may appear to be a relatively _______ area of planetary science, it is important to realize that the Moon’s surface and interior retain records that shed light on the histories of all terrestrial planets.
translation: 尽管月球地质学看似只是行星科学中一个相对狭窄的领域，但必须认识到，月球的表面和内部保留着揭示所有类地行星历史的记录。

stem: Frequently blamed for making _______ coverage decisions, insurance companies are eager to avoid additional bad press.
translation: 保险公司经常因做出冷酷无情的承保赔付决定而饱受指责，因此急于避免招致更多的负面报道。

stem: Beauford Delaney’s dynamic depictions of Harlem and Greenwich Village, dating from 1929 to 1953, _______ the energy of the city, while the equally captivating abstract compositions from his Paris years of 1953 to 1979 demonstrate his sustained exploration of color.
translation: 博福德·德莱尼创作于1929年至1953年间对哈莱姆区和格林威治村的生动描绘传达了这座城市的活力，而他在1953年至1979年巴黎时期同样引人入胜的抽象画作则展现了他对色彩的持续探索。

stem: While spectroscopy may be an obscure tool, there is nothing correspondingly _______ about claims concerning its importance: it proved that the rest of the universe is built from the same kinds of atoms as we are.
translation: 尽管光谱学可能是一种鲜为人知的工具，但关于其重要性的主张却毫无深奥晦涩之处：它证明了宇宙的其他部分与我们一样是由同种原子构成的。

stem: Most children overgeneralize the rule that to form a plural you add “s”—saying “foots,” for example, instead of “feet”—but they become grammatically more _______ as they get older.
translation: 大多数儿童会过度套用加“s”构成复数的规则——例如说“foots”而不是“feet”——但随着年龄增长，他们在语法上会变得更加熟练。

stem: Despite their current reputation, the original Luddites were neither opposed to innovative technology nor _______ using it: many were highly skilled machine operators in the textile industry.
translation: 尽管最初的卢德派分子如今名声不佳，但他们既不反对创新技术，也不拙于使用这些技术：其中许多人曾是纺织行业高技能的机器操作工。

stem: The author’s comparisons of Sontag’s work to that of Walter Benjamin are _______: while the former is admittedly an influential figure, the latter is undoubtedly one of the most important critics of his era.
translation: 作者将桑塔格的作品与瓦尔特·本雅明的作品相提并论是言过其实的：虽然前者固然是一位有影响力的人物，但后者无疑是他那个时代最重要的评论家之一。

stem: The author’s description of the _______ contamination of ocean water with plastic material—and resulting threat to marine life—constitutes a valuable lesson in the urgency of managing trash more responsibly than we currently do.
translation: 作者对塑料垃圾在海水中无处不在的污染及其对海洋生物所造成威胁的描述，深刻说明了以比目前更负责任的方式处理垃圾的紧迫性。

stem: What Dr. Walther has shown is that many of the standard statistical techniques that are supposed to insure against _______ correlations are inadequate in this case.
translation: 瓦尔瑟博士的研究表明，许多原本旨在防范虚假相关的标准统计技术在这种情况下是不充分的。

stem: The team of physicists regarded the data as too _______ not to study with fresh eyes and fresh questions.
translation: 物理学家团队认为这些数据过于反常特殊，以至于不能不由全新的视角和全新的问题来加以深入研究。

stem: Taxonomy has gained a reputation as _______ science, a reputation that is not mitigated by the incessant changing of the names of organisms and the seemingly haphazard approach taken to the definition of taxa.
translation: 分类学落得了一个武断随意的学科名声，而生物名称的不断变动以及对分类群定义看似随意的方式，并未减轻这种负面名声。

stem: As the global climate warms, some deserts, expanding to higher latitudes, are beginning to _______ fertile regions.
translation: 随着全球气候变暖，一些向更高纬度扩张的沙漠正开始取代肥沃的土地。

stem: The plays of Alice Childress (1916-1994) often present Black women in confrontations that rearrange what qualifies as _______ behavior: Childress’s heroines, for example, often question the social protocols limiting the content of public conversations.
translation: 爱丽丝·柴尔德里斯（1916—1994）的戏剧经常展现黑人女性在冲突中的表现，重新定义了何为常规规范行为：例如，柴尔德里斯笔下的女主角常常质疑限制公众对话内容的社交礼仪。

stem: A glance at the night sky may suggest that the universe is _______: the tableau of stars seen last night appears virtually identical to the one that fascinated our ancestors thousands of years ago.
translation: 抬头仰望夜空可能会让人觉得宇宙是静止不变的：昨夜看到的繁星图景与数千年前吸引我们祖先的星空看起来几乎毫无二致。

stem: Because organisms can’t _______ sodium, as they can do with nitrogen, carbon, and phosphorus, they need external sources to replenish this vital element constantly.
translation: 由于生物体无法像储存氮、碳和磷那样在体内储存钠元素，因此它们需要外部来源来不断补充这种必需元素。

stem: The appropriateness of _______ with those to whom one owes loyalty is evident in the Confucian view that rulers who are not living up to their roles should be urged to rectify their behavior.
translation: 儒家主张应当劝诫没有尽到职责的统治者纠正其行为，这清楚地表明向自己效忠的对象提出规劝谏言是完全正当的。

stem: The dating of the prehistoric monument Stonehenge necessarily entails a great deal of speculation, with the result that several rather _______ chronologies have been proposed.
translation: 对史前巨石阵遗址的年代测定必然伴随着大量的推测，导致人们提出了几种截然不同且互不一致的年代序列。

stem: Williams argues that philosophy has become _______ occupation these days, and that it should rather be “part of a more general attempt to make the best sense of our life.”
translation: 威廉斯认为，如今哲学已经变成了一种深奥晦涩的行当，而它本应是“为了更好理解我们的生活而进行的更广泛尝试的一部分”。

stem: The writer’s expression of _______ sentiments in fluid, vigorous prose is a strange blending of the high and the low—like an opera performed by sloppily dressed, unkempt musicians.
translation: 该作者用流畅强健的散文表达低劣卑俗的情感，呈现出一种雅俗混杂的奇异结合——宛如衣衫不整、蓬头垢面的乐师所演奏的歌剧。

stem: Researchers studying India’s monsoon weather have evaluated more than 100 years of rain gauge data; _______ such information, South American scientists are forced to reconstruct centuries of monsoon history by analyzing lake-bottom sediment cores.
translation: 研究印度季风气候的研究人员评估了100多年的雨量计数据；由于缺乏此类信息，南美洲科学家不得不通过分析湖底沉积物岩芯来重建数个世纪的季风历史。

stem: The author’s point is not that people should be _______ science; he is careful to point out that what science is discovering about humans, for example, is certainly important and worthy of careful consideration.
translation: 作者的观点并非认为人们应该轻视科学；他十分谨慎地指出，例如科学对人类的发现无疑非常重要，值得认真对待。

stem: Land near Bangladesh’s coastal rivers is _______: temporary islands, or chars, form in the main river as sediments are deposited and then disappear during floods.
translation: 孟加拉国沿海河流附近的土地是短暂易逝的：泥沙沉积在主流中形成临时岛屿（沙洲），随后又在洪水期间被冲刷消失。

stem: Some critics, noting the power of photographs to manipulate perceptions, _______ the photographer’s work for intentionally misrepresenting its subjects.
translation: 一些评论家注意到摄影作品操纵公众认知的力量，严厉谴责该摄影师的作品故意歪曲其拍摄对象。

stem: Reading proved liberating for the young Frederick Douglass, since it _______ concepts and narratives that confirmed and illuminated his experiences.
translation: 阅读对年轻的弗雷德里克·道格拉斯而言是一种解放，因为阅读提供了能够印证并阐明他自身经历的概念与叙事。

stem: Technological developments in the nineteenth century took longer to _______ than they do today: many of that century’s advances were known to scientists but not to average people.
translation: 19世纪的技术成果传播扩散所需的时间比现在更长：那个时期的许多科技进步科学家们早已知晓，却未能普及到普通大众。

stem: The scientific study of laughter faces a frustrating paradox: ideal experiments take place in rigidly controlled environments with all but the most salient variables eliminated, but such sterile settings are often _______ laughter.
translation: 对笑的科学研究面临着一个令人沮丧的悖论：理想的实验环境需要受到严格控制，排除除最显著变量以外的所有变量，但这种毫无生气的刻板环境往往不利于笑声的产生。

stem: One of the incongruities of modern industry, according to Reck and Graedel, is that we manufacture modern products with the most sophisticated technologies available yet generally adopt relatively _______ approaches to recycling them.
translation: 雷克和格雷德尔指出，现代工业的不协调之处之一在于，我们采用现有的最尖端技术来制造现代产品，但在回收利用它们时却普遍采用相对原始粗糙的方法。

stem: The online discussion became so ferocious that some participants were reluctant to continue logging in for fear of being confronted with yet another _______.
translation: 这场网络讨论变得异常激烈，以至于一些参与者因害怕面对又一次长篇大论的抨击怒斥而不再愿意登录。

stem: Because the country’s media are now operating freely and the electoral authorities have been changed, there should be no repeat of the _______ of last year’s election, when media coverage and vote counts were manipulated by the intelligence agency.
translation: 由于该国媒体现已自由运作，选举管理机构也已改组，去年大选中媒体报道和计票遭情报机构操纵的欺诈诡计应当不会重演。

stem: The number of recent interviews and television appearances suggests that the formerly _______ politician has done an about-face.
translation: 近期接受采访和在电视上露面的频繁程度表明，这位过去沉默寡言的政客态度彻底改变了。

stem: A strong basic science program can be _______: the rate of return on capital invested in basic science is about three times that of capital invested in applied research and development.
translation: 一个强有力的基础科学项目可以是收益丰厚的：投资于基础科学的资本回报率大约是投资于应用研发的三倍。

stem: Though initially presented in a blaze of hyperbole, the thesis is stated more _______ in the ensuing paragraphs.
translation: 尽管该论点最初是以极其夸张的言辞提出的，但在接下来的段落中阐述得更加理智客观。

stem: According to Peter Kwapong, rural Ghanaian farmers, despite regarding stingless bees as useful animals, by and large have not _______ the bees as economic resources.
translation: 根据彼得·夸庞的说法，加纳农村的农民尽管认为无刺蜂是有益昆虫，但总体上尚未将这种蜜蜂作为经济资源加以开发利用。

stem: Mary Isin’s book on Turkish sweets is written in the celebratory mode, yet many of the chapters also have _______ quality since quite a few of the desserts she writes about have largely disappeared.
translation: 玛丽·伊辛关于土耳其甜点的书是以赞美歌颂的笔调写成的，然而许多章节也带有一种哀伤挽歌般的特质，因为她所描写的不少甜点已基本绝迹。

stem: While the _______ of reliable sources in later narratives makes many details of the early history of China’s Zhou dynasty unverifiable, the Zhou rulers’ successful rise to power is certain.
translation: 尽管后世叙述中可靠史料的匮乏使得中国周朝早期历史的许多细节无法考证，但周朝统治者成功崛起掌权却是确凿无疑的。

stem: In modern agriculture, crop growth and crop protection can be viewed as _______ processes: by encouraging rapid growth with generous fertilizer treatments we may in some cases unintentionally reduce the ability of plants to defend themselves.
translation: 在现代农业中，作物生长与作物保护可被视为相互冲突对立的过程：通过大量施肥促进作物快速生长，有时可能会无意中降低植物自我防御的能力。

stem: Although collisions between the largest planetesimals in a planetesimal belt are _______, they can release large amounts of debris when they occur.
translation: 尽管微行星带中最大微行星之间的碰撞十分罕见，但碰撞一旦发生，就会释放出大量的碎片。

stem: The _______ markings on some prehistoric bone and antler fragments could be accidents or the result of doodling but may also represent a form of communication such as tally marks or even early calendars.
translation: 某些史前骨骼和鹿角残片上神秘莫测的刻痕可能是意外造成的或随手涂鸦的结果，但也可能代表着某种交流形式，例如计数符号甚至是早期的历法。

stem: A recent discussion on biological development promotes “organicism” as a scientifically _______ view, one which the authors quickly distinguish from the dubious and metaphysically laden “vitalism”.
translation: 最近一项关于生物发育的讨论将“机体论”推崇为一种在科学上站得住脚的观点，作者们迅速将其与可疑且充斥形而上学色彩的“活力论”区分开来。

stem: In her study of the composer, Fiona Richards fearlessly digs into biographical details, avoiding the _______ found in the work of other, more circumspect biographers.
translation: 菲奥娜·理查兹在对这位作曲家的研究中毫不畏缩地深入挖掘传记细节，避免了其他更为谨慎的传记作家作品中常见的含糊其辞与犹豫摇摆。

stem: Automated text-matching and plagiarism-detection services must be _______ human expertise: machines alone cannot detect plagiarism of ideas, that is, expressing someone else’s idea in one’s own words.
translation: 自动文本匹配和抄袭检测服务必须辅以人类的专业知识：仅凭机器无法检测出思想层面的抄袭，即用自己的语言转述他人的思想。

stem: The 1966 Mexican art exhibition “Confrontation 66” seemed to define the Mexican art world as one in which political alignment was _______, yet painter Joy Laville rose to prominence with paintings devoid of contentiousness.
translation: 1966年墨西哥举办的“对抗66”艺术展似乎将墨西哥艺术界定义为一个政治站队不可避免的领域，然而画家乔伊·拉维尔却凭借毫无争议冲突色彩的画作声名鹊起。

stem: Just as the short strings of a violin cannot produce the deep, long-wavelength notes of a double bass, so photons—which are vibrations not of strings but of electromagnetic fields—are _______ by the physical characteristics of objects that conduct electricity.
translation: 正如小提琴的短弦无法发出低音提琴深沉的长波长音符一样，光子——即电磁场而非琴弦的振动——也受到导电物体物理特性的限制与约束。

stem: In medieval China, the Confucian emphasis on rites as an outward manifestation of virtue explains Chinese bureaucrats’ _______ the accurate performance of tributary rituals by foreigners at the imperial court.
translation: 在中国古代中世纪时期，儒家将礼仪视作美德外在体现的强调，解释了朝廷官员对外国人在朝廷上准确行使朝贡礼仪的极度关注与执着。

stem: The breathless pace of the Broadway adaptation of Alice Walker’s The Color Purple was _______, given the adaptation’s determination to cram in so many of the incidents that appear in the original source.
translation: 鉴于百老汇改编版《紫颜色》（改编自爱丽丝·沃克的作品）执意塞入原著中出现的如此之多的情节，其令人喘不过气来的紧凑节奏是不可避免的。

stem: The big bang is actually a relatively _______ idea, scientifically speaking; just a few decades ago, the big bang would have been hotly contested, and a few decades before that, it hadn’t even been considered.
translation: 从科学角度来看，大爆炸理论实际上是一个相对新颖的想法；就在几十年前，大爆炸假说还会引发激烈争论，而在那之前的几十年，人们甚至根本没有考虑过这种设想。

stem: The author illustrates her book about mid-nineteenth-century Paris with photographs revealing the _______ conditions that prevailed in the city: sewage can be seen draining onto streets lined with crumbling buildings.
translation: 作者在她关于19世纪中叶巴黎的著作中配以照片，揭示了当时笼罩该市的恶劣不卫生的环境：照片中可以看到污水直接排入两旁伫立着残破建筑的街道上。

stem: “Revolutionary” and “unique” are words that have become _______: every century in human history is described as unique, and every year, somewhere in the world, some event is characterized as revolutionary.
translation: “革命性的”和“独一无二的”已经成了被过度使用的陈词滥调：人类历史上的每一个世纪都被描述为独一无二，而每一年世界上某个地方的某起事件都会被冠以革命性的特征。

stem: So great is the reputation of the artist Gilbert Stuart (1755-1828) for _______ that some modern specialists routinely discount assertions that he made in correspondence with owners of his paintings.
translation: 艺术家吉尔伯特·斯图尔特（1755—1828）说谎掩饰的名声是如此之大，以至于一些现代专家通常会对他与画作主人的书信中所作的陈述打折扣。

stem: In the 1990s, the limited color palette of display screens was _______: the electronics industry, working through a United Nations agency, adopted a worldwide standard color gamut that all televisions should be able to display.
translation: 20世纪90年代，显示屏有限的色彩范围被正式规范化：电子工业界通过联合国的一个机构确立了所有电视机都应能显示的全球标准色域。

stem: Researchers who study pollinator behavior are increasingly interested in multicomponent floral signals, but they often focus on how individual components are learned by pollinators rather than on the benefit of signal _______ per se.
translation: 研究传粉媒介行为的研究人员对复合花卉信号越来越感兴趣，但他们往往侧重于传粉昆虫如何学习各个单独成分，而不是信号本身的复杂性所带来的益处。

stem: Herodotus is not _______ concerning some of the more fantastic stories related in his History: as he repeatedly observes, “I must tell what is said, but I am not at all bound to believe it.”
translation: 希罗多德对于他在《历史》中所记述的某些更为荒诞离奇的故事并不轻信：正如他反复强调的那样，“我必须记录人们所说的话，但我完全没有义务去相信它。”

stem: Aboriginal people of Victoria, Australia, neither rejected Western material culture nor demonstrated an obsession with it; in fact, Western artifacts such as pipes and handkerchiefs were appreciated for their symbolic rather than their _______ value.
translation: 澳大利亚维多利亚州的土著居民既没有排斥西方物质文化，也没有表现出对其痴迷；事实上，烟斗和手帕等西方物品受到青睐，是因为其象征价值而非实用价值。

stem: That the announcement of the new treatment was greeted with _______ is hardly surprising given the claims made for it, but attitudes were markedly tempered once the paucity of supporting data became apparent.
translation: 鉴于对新疗法疗效所作的宣称，该疗法的宣布受到狂喜欢呼并不令人意外，但一旦支持性数据的匮乏显露出来，人们的态度便明显降温了。

stem: The adipose tissue in which our bodies store fat from the food we eat has traditionally been thought of as _______, but in reality this tissue constitutes a dynamic organ, not a mere repository.
translation: 身体用来储存食物脂肪的脂肪组织传统上一直被认为是惰性的，但实际上该组织是一个动态器官，绝不仅仅是一个单纯的仓库。

stem: Campbell argues that because life takes eons to get started, habitability of extrasolar planets isn’t solely determined by the balance of temperature and chemicals; it also depends on the _______ of these factors.
translation: 坎贝尔认为，由于生命需要漫长的时间才能孕育产生，太阳系外行星的宜居性不仅取决于温度与化学物质的平衡，还取决于这些因素的稳定性与持续性。

stem: Even though it is generally accepted that some features of water clocks came to be incorporated in mechanical clocks, insufficient attention has been paid to precisely how mechanical clocks _______ water clocks.
translation: 尽管人们普遍认为水钟的某些特征被融入了机械钟之中，但对于机械钟究竟是如何源自水钟的，目前关注还远远不够。

stem: The author argues that by setting the agenda, constraining the issues discussed, and crafting “talking points,” political elites are ultimately able to _______ the choices available to voters.
translation: 作者指出，政治精英通过设定议程、限制讨论议题以及精心构思“谈话要点”，最终能够限制并圈定选民所能拥有的选择范围。

stem: Unlike many artists, who made multiple impressions of the same image to sell and make more money, Mary Cassatt often reworked an image on different plates, as if most fascinated by the process of _______.
translation: 许多艺术家印制同一画面的多幅印张来出售牟利，玛丽·卡萨特则与之不同，她经常在不同的印版上反复修改画面，似乎对修改过程本身最为着迷。

stem: Because there has been such a _______ of information about Jorge Luis Borges’ personal life, it is easy to understand the eager excitement generated by Borges, a selection from the diaries of his closest friend.
translation: 由于关于豪尔赫·路易斯·博尔赫斯个人生活的信息一直极其匮乏，因此不难理解他最亲密朋友的日记选辑《博尔赫斯》出版时所引发的热切期待与兴奋。

stem: At public appearances the leader was remarkably taciturn, typically making _______ observations before turning the floor over to a colleague.
translation: 在公开露面时，这位领导人异常沉默寡言，通常在草草发表简短评论后便将发言权交给同事。

stem: Since beavers rely on auditory signals such as the tail slap and whining and hissing, we can infer that their hearing is _______, although we don’t know the exact sensitivity and performance of their acoustical sense.
translation: 既然海狸依靠拍击尾巴、哀鸣和嘶嘶声等听觉信号，我们就可以推断它们的听觉是起作用且健全的，尽管我们尚不清楚其听觉的具体灵敏度与表现。

stem: Charles Dickens is a notoriously _______ figure for biographers: as Claire Tomalin writes in her book on him, “Everyone finds their own version of Charles Dickens.”
translation: 查尔斯·狄更斯对传记作者来说是一个出了名难以捉摸的人物：正如克莱尔·托马林在她关于他的书中所写的那样，“每个人都能找到属于自己的查尔斯·狄更斯版本。”

stem: Examination of eighteenth-century correspondence from colonial Pennsylvania reveals that men generally sent love letters to the friends and family of the women they _______ rather than to the women themselves.
translation: 对殖民时期宾夕法尼亚州18世纪书信的考证表明，男性通常会将情书寄给他们所追求女性的朋友和家人，而不是直接寄给女性本人。

stem: Sheila refused to patronize all-you-can-eat restaurants, for she felt that enjoying them required a certain _______ of which she disapproved.
translation: 希拉拒绝光顾自助餐厅，因为她觉得要享受自助餐就必须具备一种她所不赞同的贪吃与不知餍足。

stem: Veins of copper ore can be quarried from Earth’s surface, but deeper extraction requires ever more bedrock to be excavated in proportion to ore, so that such a procedure becomes increasingly _______ for mining companies.
translation: 铜矿脉可以从地表进行露天开采，但更深层的开采需要按矿石比例挖掘越来越多的基岩，因此对采矿公司而言，这种作业方式变得越来越不切实际且不可行。

stem: Given that Mr. Harris was obviously sophisticated and worldly, his failure to do well in the position can hardly be ascribed to _______.
translation: 鉴于哈里斯先生显然成熟练达且通晓世故，他在该职位上的失败很难归咎于少不更事与幼稚天真。

stem: The reliable production of usable energy through the controlled fusion of hydrogen atoms into helium remains an elusive dream: even the most ardent efforts to achieve it have thus far been _______.
translation: 通过将氢原子受控聚变为氦来可靠地生产可用能源仍是一个遥不可及的梦想：迄今为止，即使为实现这一目标所付出的最热切努力也都屡屡受挫。

stem: To describe as unrewarding a book so diligently researched and painstakingly thorough would, at first glance, seem _______.
translation: 把一本考据如此勤勉、内容如此详尽细致的书评价为劳而无益，乍看之下似乎显得不近人情且粗鲁失礼。

stem: Egler’s prediction in 1947 that the introduction of mangrove trees to the Hawaiian Islands would cause sweeping ecological change was _______: extensive mangrove forests have come to displace many preexisting plant communities.
translation: 埃格勒在1947年预测将红树林引入夏威夷群岛会引发翻天覆地的生态变化，这一预见极具先见之明：大片的红树林如今已经取代了许多原有的植物群落。

stem: Some zoo animals—cheetahs, pandas, and black rhinos, for instance—are reluctant to breed in captivity, while others are too _______, creating a problem for zoos when there is no more room in the cage.
translation: 某些动物园动物——例如猎豹、大熊猫和黑犀牛——不愿在圈养环境中繁殖，而另一些动物的繁殖力却过于旺盛，当笼舍没有更多空间时便给动物园带来了难题。

stem: Building the first United States transcontinental phone line required fundamental innovations: for example, engineers created an amplifier for the electric signals to prevent them from _______ after a few miles.
translation: 建设美国第一条横贯大陆的电话线路需要根本性的技术创新：例如，工程师发明了电信号放大器，以防止信号在传输数英里后衰减消散。

stem: Early natural history collections in eighteenth-century Europe were _______: a bear’s tooth might sit incongruously alongside a piece of silverwork or, in the menagerie, a South American capybara might be housed next to an African baboon.
translation: 18世纪欧洲早期的自然史收藏从根本上讲是五花八门、杂乱并蓄的：一颗熊牙可能会突兀地摆在一件银器旁，或者在兽栏中，一只南美水豚可能与一只非洲狒狒关在一起。

stem: Despite the long history of data collection on species diversity, there is a _______ of usable data.
translation: 尽管物种多样性的数据收集历史悠久，但可用数据却十分匮乏。

stem: Motorcycle riders in London have discovered an ingenious, albeit _______ way of parking illegally without getting a ticket.
translation: 伦敦的摩托车骑手发现了一种巧妙但不道德且不诚实的方法，可以违规停车而不被开罚单。

stem: Like his fellow _______ covering the campaign tour, who rarely had the luxury of spending more than one night in one place, Tony had his bags packed well before the evening fund-raiser.
translation: 就像那些报道竞选巡回活动、很少能在同一个地方停留超过一晚的四处奔波的随行同行一样，托尼在晚间筹款活动之前很久就收拾好了行李。

stem: The painter Fu Baoshi lived and worked through a tumultuous period in Chinese history, _______ by exceptional talent and a steely dedication to his art.
translation: 画家傅抱石在中国历史上一段动荡混乱的时期生活和创作，依靠过人的才华和对艺术钢铁般的执着追求得以支撑前行。

stem: Vast, complex, and deeply entrenched, the administrative apparatus that answered to Egypt’s Queen Cleopatra was _______ instrument with which to govern.
translation: 听命于埃及艳后克利奥帕特拉的行政机构庞大、复杂且根深蒂固，是一个笨重难操控的统治工具。

stem: Piersma and Gill suggest that bar-tailed godwits—long-billed shorebirds of the Eurasian and Alaskan tundra—rank among the most _______ of the long-range fliers, traveling 11,000 kilometers nonstop across the Pacific.
translation: 皮尔斯马和吉尔认为，斑尾塍鹬——欧亚大陆和阿拉斯加苔原的长喙涉禽——属于最不知疲倦的长途飞行鸟类之一，能够不间断飞行11000公里横跨太平洋。

stem: Weak monsoon rainfall was responsible for the blackouts that cut power to half of the country because the resulting _______ of water reduced the amount of electric power produced by the country’s hydroelectric dams.
translation: 季风降雨微弱是导致该国半数地区断电的大停电的直接原因，因为由此造成的水资源匮乏减少了该国水力发电大坝的发电量。

stem: In hindsight, it is easy to say that the geological evidence for ice ages was _______ and to wonder why such periods in the Earth’s past were not recognized earlier.
translation: 事后看来，很容易得出冰期存在的地质证据是压倒性且极其充分的结论，并让人纳闷为何地球历史上的这些时期没有更早被人们所认识。

stem: The Federal Reserve Bank is one of the most _______ institutions in the United States, yet many are not aware of the important operations and activities it has carried out during its lifetime.
translation: 美联储是美国举足轻重且不可或缺的机构之一，然而许多人并未意识到它自成立以来所开展的重要运作与活动。

stem: The news business has never been _______; like so many other businesses, it is protean in nature.
translation: 新闻业从来都不是稳定不变的；像许多其他行业一样，它本质上是千变万化的。

stem: The importance of the notion of surface in nanoscience and nanotechnology cannot be _______: in nanomaterials, in fact, surface phenomena rather than mass properties govern the chemical and biological behavior of objects.
translation: 表面这一概念在纳米科学与纳米技术中的重要性怎么强调都不为过：事实上，在纳米材料中，决定物体化学和生物行为的是表面现象而非整体质量属性。

stem: Biographies can be _______ contrivances, often too long and too detailed for their own good.
translation: 传记可能会成为令人厌烦乏味的作品，往往因篇幅过长、细节过繁而适得其反。

stem: Some historians have _______ the disjunction between the decades preceding and the ones following the political coup, ignoring the fact that the coup fell in the middle of a twenty-year period of considerable social and economic continuity.
translation: 一些历史学家夸大了这场政变前后几十年的脱节断裂，忽略了该政变其实发生在一个长达二十年的社会和经济具有相当连续性的时期当中。

stem: In a 1931 article, Duke Ellington suggested that jazz had _______ aspect: “What we could not say openly we expressed in music, and what we know as ‘jazz’ is something more than just dance music.”
translation: 杜克·埃灵顿在1931年的一篇文章中指出，爵士乐具有隐秘的一面：“我们无法公开表达的内容都抒发在音乐中，而我们所称的‘爵士乐’远不止是伴舞音乐而已。”

stem: Despite dogs’ talent for detecting those high-pitched whistles that are inaudible to us, dogs’ ability to locate sounds is _______ compared with ours.
translation: 尽管狗擅长察觉我们听不到的高音哨声，但与我们相比，狗定位声源的能力却不够精准。

stem: The coagulated latex of the gutta-percha tree, which grows wild in Sumatra, Kalimantan, and Malaya, can be formed into a natural plastic that, although inelastic under ordinary conditions, becomes _______ when placed in hot water.
translation: 生长在苏门答腊、加里曼丹和马来亚的野生马来树胶树的凝固胶乳可以制成一种天然塑料，虽然在常温常态下缺乏弹性，但放入热水中时会变得柔软易塑。

stem: Once a pop musician’s biggest source of income, recorded music now plays second fiddle to touring, endorsements, merchandise sales, and an array of other streams previously considered _______.
translation: 录制音乐曾是流行音乐人最大的收入来源，如今却退居次席，让位于巡演、代言、周边商品销售以及一系列此前被视为辅助补充性质的其他收入来源。

stem: The colors of brocaded silks made by Merina weavers in Madagascar were not _______: magenta, blue, black, pink, yellow and brown characterize pieces before 1880, while thereafter green, purple, and orange come to the fore.
translation: 马达加斯加梅里纳织工织造的织锦绸缎的颜色并非一成不变：1880年之前的作品以洋红色、蓝色、黑色、粉色、黄色和棕色为特色，而此后绿色、紫色和橙色则占据了主导地位。

stem: It can be _______ to see well-known historical figures played in films by actors who have become firmly associated in our minds with contemporary celebrity culture.
translation: 看到已在人们心中与当代名流文化紧密关联的演员在电影中扮演著名历史人物，可能会令人感到违和与不安。

stem: Despite much _______ the county’s political system, the fact that supporters failed in their attempts to change the constitution to allow the President to run again speaks well of the system’s fundamental strengths.
translation: 尽管人们对该政治体制抱有诸多怀疑，但支持者企图修宪以允许总统连任的尝试以失败告终，这充分证明了该制度根本上的稳固性与优势。

stem: Developments in neuroscience and animal behavior have led researchers to question the view that unmitigated competition is _______ animal life: in primatology, the countermovement started with research into how friendships and conflict resolution favor survival.
translation: 神经科学和动物行为学的发展促使研究人员质疑“毫无缓和的竞争是动物生存之本”这一观点：在灵长类动物学中，这种反思思潮始于对友谊和化解冲突如何有利于生存的研究。

stem: Because they view Earth’s resources as strictly limited, some environmentalists find the notion of sustainable growth to be _______, believing that self-restraint and sacrifice must be at the heart of any environmentally sound strategy for the future.
translation: 因为认为地球资源极其有限，一些环保主义者觉得“可持续增长”的概念是值得怀疑的，他们坚信自我克制与牺牲必须成为未来任何切实可行的环保战略的核心。

stem: Studies have shown that areas of the Amazon rain forest that previously were thought to be _______ have in reality been subject to disturbance and modifications by humans for thousands of years.
translation: 研究表明，此前被认为是原始未受触及的亚马孙雨林地区，实际上数千年来一直在经受人类活动的干扰与改造。

stem: Coral reefs are often referred to as the rain forests of the sea, _______ comparison given that only tropical rain forests can compete with the sheer concentration of biodiversity found in coral reefs.
translation: 珊瑚礁常被称为海洋中的热带雨林，鉴于只有热带雨林才能与珊瑚礁中惊人的生物多样性集中度相媲美，这一比喻可以说是十分恰当的。

stem: One virtue of cornmeal as a component of the diets of laborers in early Puerto Rico was the mildness of its taste, a trait that enabled it to _______ the strong flavors of other foods.
translation: 作为早期波多黎各劳工日常饮食的组成部分，玉米粉的一大优点在于其口感清淡温和，这一特性使其能够中和其他食物过于浓烈的风味。

stem: In science, _______ can sometimes inhibit understanding; indeed, the advantage of the technique for staining brain tissue developed in 1873 by Golgi was that it showed so little.
translation: 在科学研究中，细枝末节有时反而会阻碍理解；事实上，高尔基在1873年发明的脑组织染色技术的优势恰恰在于它所展现的细节极其有限。

stem: A particular problem with critics’ notions of realism with regard to dialogue in fiction is that all too often the focus is on _______ utterances and not on the flux and process of conversational interaction.
translation: 批评家在考量小说对话的现实主义时存在一个特殊问题，即他们往往过于聚焦于孤立零散的个别话语，而忽视了对话互动的流动与动态演进过程。

stem: The _______ of governmental subsidies to obscure airports that are rarely used underscores the political difficulties of cutting funds from even the most unnecessary projects.
translation: 政府对极少使用的偏僻机场长期持续提供补贴，这一现象凸显了哪怕是从最不必要的项目中削减经费，在政治上也面临重重困难。

stem: Though it lacked _______ demeanor, Guatemala City was nonetheless a compelling place to be in 1954.
translation: 尽管危地马拉城缺乏迷人可人的风采，但它在1954年依然是一个极具吸引力的地方。

stem: In spite of its outwardly _______ demeanor, Guatemala City was a compelling place to be in 1954.
translation: 尽管危地马拉城外表显得平淡无奇且日复一日，但在1954年，它依然是一个极具吸引力的地方。

stem: There are too many characters, too many subplots, and no one clearly defined protagonist, making for _______ story.
translation: 由于出场人物过多、支线情节繁杂，且缺乏一个明确清晰的主角，这使得整个故事显得松散无焦点。

stem: This novel is not great literature: there are too many characters, too many subplots, and no clearly defined protagonist, making for _______ story.
translation: 这部小说算不上优秀的文学作品：人物过多，支线庞杂，且没有一个清晰明确的主角，导致整个故事结构散漫、缺乏章法。

stem: In a production process that is complex and often unpredictable, roles that start out discretely defined may become quite _______.
translation: 在一个复杂且往往难以预测的生产流程中，起初界限分明的职责角色可能会变得非常灵活多变。

stem: Muriel Spark suggested that Mary Shelley’s prose style was often verbose and platitudinous, the very opposite of Spark’s favored _______.
translation: 缪丽尔·斯帕克认为玛丽·雪莱的散文风格往往冗长且充满陈词滥调，与斯帕克本人所崇尚的简洁凝练截然相反。

stem: The Harlem Renaissance has been studied extensively as a literary and visual arts movement, but recent scholars have described the role of music as more than _______, in fact, as having made the Harlem Renaissance possible.
translation: 哈莱姆文艺复兴作为一场文学与视觉艺术运动已被广泛研究，但近期的学者指出，音乐在其中所起的作用绝非次要附带的，事实上，正是音乐使得哈莱姆文艺复兴成为可能。

stem: Controversial new research suggests that earthquakes have atmospheric _______: subtle increases in electron density have been recorded above the quake’s epicenter prior to the recent onset of multiple large earthquakes and medium-sized earthquakes.
translation: 一项颇具争议的新研究表明，地震在大气中存在前兆：在近期多起大中型地震发生之前，震中上空均记录到了电子密度的微幅上升。

stem: Because they require abstraction and generalization, many theories end up _______ practical relevance as they fail to capture the richness and complexity of phenomena encountered in real settings.
translation: 由于需要抽象和概括，许多理论因未能捕捉到现实环境中各种现象的丰富性与复杂性，最终缺乏实际应用价值。

stem: _______ as ever at eighty-three, Williamson berated the journalists hovering outside his home with a constant stream of abuse.
translation: 威廉姆森虽已八十三岁高龄，但脾气依旧暴躁易怒，对着聚集在他家门外的记者们破口大骂、斥责不休。

stem: Only novel ideas should be awarded patents; if a concept is _______ to practitioners in a given field or has previously been published in almost any fashion, that fact should invalidate the application.
translation: 只有具备新颖性的构想才应被授予专利；若某个概念对相关领域的从业人员而言是显而易见的，或先前已通过几乎任何方式公开发表过，该申请便应归于无效。

stem: The awards and critical acclaim for the author’s new novel were not unexpected, as her previous works had already secured their author reputation for literary _______.
translation: 这位作家的新小说斩获诸多奖项并备受好评并不出人意料，因为她之前的作品早已为她确立了文学造诣精湛卓绝的声誉。

stem: We wallow in bad news, tales of how things went wrong, but we have only the most _______ discussions regarding how they might go right.
translation: 我们沉溺于坏消息以及各种事情如何搞砸的故事，然而对于事情可能如何向好的方向发展，我们却仅进行了最浮于表面、草草了事的讨论。

stem: Scientists are finding that the adult brain is far more _______ than they once thought: our behavior and environment can cause substantial rewiring of the brain or a reorganization of its functions and where they are located.
translation: 科学家们发现，成年人的大脑远比他们以往认为的更具可塑性：我们的行为和环境能够促使大脑神经回路发生显著重构，或重新组织其功能及分布区域。

stem: Though it once seemed so disastrous, with hindsight the disintegration of the artists collective is revealed as generative, for each of the dispersed factions acted as a _______ reproducing the collective’s founding inspiration in a new setting.
translation: 尽管这个艺术家团体的瓦解一度看似灾难深重，但事后看来却颇具启发与生成意义，因为分散开来的每一个派别都犹如一颗萌芽的种子，在新的环境中重新播撒并传承着该团体创立之初的灵感。

stem: As _______ they are, earthquakes are a boon to geologists because they produce seismic waves that can be analyzed for information as to what lies in the invisible depths of Earth.
translation: 尽管地震极具破坏性与灾难性，但对地质学家而言却是一大福音，因为地震产生的地震波可供分析，从而揭示地球隐秘深处的信息。

stem: Mushrooms have been picked by people since the age of the hunter-gatherers, who had to _______ their own ways of distinguishing the edible from the poisonous mushrooms.
translation: 人类自狩猎采集时代起就开始采摘蘑菇，当时的人们不得不自己想方设法摸索出区分可食用蘑菇与有毒蘑菇的途径。

stem: It is possible to mistake the constant stimulation offered by the Internet for _______: we can come to believe that if we are busy, we are focused.
translation: 人们很容易将互联网带来的持续刺激误认为是真正的专注投入：我们常常误以为只要自己忙个不停，就是在聚精会神。

stem: Until the 1960s, predictions of the effect of winds on the ocean waves were _______ and forecasts of wave heights during storms were consequently unreliable.
translation: 直到20世纪60年代，人们对风力对海浪影响的预测仍处于简陋粗糙的阶段，因此暴风雨期间对浪高的预报往往并不可靠。

stem: Secord’s bold experiment in a different kind of history remains just that—a _______ narrative form that has not yet achieved its full potential.
translation: 塞科德在一种新型历史书写上的大胆尝试目前仍仅止于此——一种羽翼未丰的新兴叙事形式，尚未完全展现其全部潜力。

stem: Barnes did her best to draw the spotlight back to herself and to her wide grievances: _______ by a claque of rowdy supporters, she delivered a fulsome diatribe against her former associate.
translation: 巴恩斯竭力将公众关注拉回到自己以及她广泛的不满诉求上：在一群喧闹拥趸的怂恿煽动下，她对自己的前合伙人发表了一通言辞激烈的严厉抨击。

stem: Though silicon fiber lasers appear _______, achieving optimal performance would require the development of both better materials and better microstructures.
translation: 尽管硅光纤激光器前景十分诱人且大有希望，但要实现最佳性能，仍需在更优质的材料和更完善的微观结构两方面取得突破。

stem: What distinguishes the Hadhrami Sada is their ability to _______ their own particular identity as Yemeni and at the same time become assimilated into the various societies to which they have immigrated.
translation: 哈德拉米·萨达人的独特之处在于，他们既能够珍视并恪守自己作为也门人的独特身份认同，同时又能顺利融入所移民的各个不同社会。

stem: Hillary proposed that the tracks purportedly made by a mysterious giant creature in the Himalayas could be explained by the tendency of tracks in the snow to melt and elongate and transforming something as _______ as fox tracks into large, human-like prints.
translation: 希拉里提出，喜马拉雅山脉中据称由神秘巨型生物留下的踪迹，可以用雪中脚印融化拉长的现象来解释，正是这种现象将普通寻常的狐狸脚印转变成了巨大且类似人类的足迹。

stem: Although the establishment of risk exposure limits and other safety regulations is generally presented as _______, risk-related decisions often contain value-based judgments regarding which risks to accept.
translation: 尽管设定风险暴露限值及其他安全规章通常被标榜为客观公正、不偏不倚的，但与风险相关的决策往往包含了关于应承受何种风险的基于价值观的判断。

stem: _______ neuroscience’s explanatory power, Patricia Churchland maintains that questions that have been discussed to no effect by philosophers over many centuries are solvable once rephrased as questions of neuroscience.
translation: 作为神经科学解释力的积极倡导者与拥护者，帕特丽夏·丘奇兰坚称，哲学家们数个世纪以来讨论无果的问题，一旦被重新表述为神经科学问题便迎刃而解。

stem: If observations of water vapor eruptions from Jupiter’s moon Europa are accurate, they only increase Europa’s _______; such plumes allow direct sampling of the moon’s interior, and perhaps Europa’s subsurface ocean itself, by passing spacecraft.
translation: 如果对木卫二欧罗巴水蒸气喷发活动的观测属实，这只会进一步增加欧罗巴的科学吸引力；因为此类羽流使得飞掠而过的航天器能够对该卫星内部、乃至其地下海洋本身直接进行样本采集。

stem: Booker T. Washington was always a welcome guest at the White House: although his aloofness _______ intimate conversation, the president felt entirely at ease in his company.
translation: 布克·T·华盛顿一直是白宫的贵客：尽管他的疏离感阻碍了亲近私密的深谈，但总统与他相处时依然感到十分轻松自在。

stem: Although boredom is _______, recent research indicates that excessive amounts of it can be harmful to health.
translation: 尽管无聊看似微不足道，但近期的研究表明，过度无聊可能会损害身心健康。

stem: Globalization has made ethnic entrepreneurship resilient in postindustrial economies: well represented in the small business sector in the United States, ethnic entrepreneurship has been _______ by the volatile tides of international migration.
translation: 全球化赋予了后工业经济体中族裔创业顽强的生命力：族裔创业在美国小型企业领域表现亮眼，并凭借国际移民潮的汹涌流动而得以长期维持。

stem: In Southern California, white abalone populations have waned dramatically and black abalone populations have likewise _______.
translation: 在南加利福尼亚州，白鲍的种群数量急剧下降，而黑鲍的种群数量同样出现了灾难性骤减。

stem: The author’s approach to her subject is less _______ than that of some of her predecessors in the field, though here and there she cautiously takes a stand on a potentially divisive issue.
translation: 与该领域的一些前辈相比，这位作者对待其研究主题的方式没有那么充满争议与偏向性，尽管在个别潜在的分歧议题上，她依然谨慎地表达了立场。

stem: With Duncan’s ambitious study, Chesnutt appears finally to have outgrown the _______ treatment he once received from literary historians and critics for whom he typically served as a merely transitional figure in the African American tradition.
translation: 随着邓肯这一宏大研究的问世，切斯纳特似乎终于摆脱了文学史家和批评家过去对其敷衍草率的对待——在以往的评价中，他通常仅被视作非裔美国文学传统中一个无关紧要的过渡性人物。

stem: Geologists’ customary distinction between planetary mantle and core material appears increasingly _______: liquid oxides can be considered either molten mantle constituents or electrically conducting core components.
translation: 地质学家传统上对行星地幔与地核物质的划分显得愈发站不住脚：液态氧化物既可以被视为熔融的地幔成分，也可以被视作具有导电性的地核组成部分。

stem: It is surprising, given the exquisite _______ of its arguments, that the central thesis of A Theory of Justice can be stated so simply.
translation: 鉴于其论证过程极其精妙细腻，令人惊叹的是，《正义论》的核心主张竟然能够被概括得如此简练明确。

stem: Under temperate conditions, the effects of climate on an environment are often muted and intermingled, so that the relationships between stimuli and reactions are difficult to isolate, but under extreme conditions such relationships become more _______.
translation: 在温和气候条件下，气候对环境的影响往往较为微弱且彼此交织，以至于外界刺激与生态反应之间的关系极难单独剥离；然而在极端条件下，这种关系则变得更加显著而清晰。

stem: How much corruption exists in internationally funded development projects is a matter of _______, though one well-supported estimate is that it might affect 40 percent or more of such projects.
translation: 国际资助的发展项目中究竟存在多少腐败仍是一个推测与猜测的问题，尽管一项证据充分的估算表明，这类腐败可能波及到40%甚至更多的项目。

stem: The traditional Japanese tea ceremony remains _______ practice in the country, even though the number of people performing it has been falling since the 1980s.
translation: 传统的日本茶道在该国依然是一项极具代表性且显要的文化习俗，尽管自20世纪80年代以来修习茶道的人数一直在持续下降。

stem: Despite _______ prevention program, the United States wheat crop was crippled by an epidemic of stem rust disease in 1916 and, to a lesser degree, in 1917.
translation: 尽管推行了广泛全面的防治计划，美国的小麦收成在1916年以及在稍轻程度上的1917年，依然因秆锈病的蔓延而遭受了毁灭性打击。

stem: In our solar system, Earth is the most _______ of the rocky, or terrestrial, planets, so when first searching beyond the solar system, scientists were not accustomed to planets of similar composition but many times the mass.
translation: 在太阳系中，地球是岩石质类地行星中体积与质量最为庞大的，因此在最初搜寻太阳系外行星时，科学家们对成分类似但质量大上数倍的行星感到很不适应。

stem: The book, designed to help children grasp the idea that water is a valuable resource, includes practical suggestions for water conservation, presented in a manner that is consistently helpful and encouraging, never _______.
translation: 这本书旨在帮助儿童认识到水是宝贵的资源，书中提供了节约用水的实用建议，叙述方式始终充满启发与鼓励，绝无尖锐刺耳或咄咄逼人的说教。

stem: For those attempting the art, the record of past futurologists’ prognostications can be _______: it includes many confident predictions of technological revolutions that never happened, such as domed cities and nuclear-powered cars.
translation: 对于那些尝试进行未来预测的人来说，翻阅过往未来学家的预测记录是一件发人深省、令人谦卑的事：其中包含了对诸多从未实现的科技革命的笃定预言，比如圆顶穹顶城市和核动力汽车。

stem: Every great museum is _______ institution: a repository for valuable objects, a pleasure palace, a center for scholarship, a tastemaker, a focus of national or regional pride a magnet for tourism and urban development.
translation: 每座伟大的博物馆都是一个功能多元且复合的机构：它既是珍贵文物的宝库、令人赏心悦目的游赏殿堂、学术研究的中心、大众品味的引领者，也是国家或地方自豪感的集聚地，以及推动旅游业和城市发展的强大磁石。

stem: The safety features of modern cars have actually had _______ effect on people’s driving: drivers are lulled into a false sense of security by their cars’ sophistication and therefore drive less attentively.
translation: 现代汽车的安全配置实际上对人们的驾驶行为产生了有害的不良影响：汽车的高精尖技术使驾驶员产生了一种虚假的安全感，导致他们在驾驶时注意力涣散、不够专注。

stem: Though the art of writing was well established in Egypt and Mesopotamia long before the Shang period, the Chinese writing that appeared then seems to have been an entirely _______ development.
translation: 尽管早在商代之前，书写艺术就已在埃及和两河流域确立成熟，但当时中国出现的文字似乎完全是一种本土独立孕育发展的产物。

stem: Critics have raved about the beauty of Peck’s prose, but in his fiction, at least, the diction has only gotten more portentous with time, the writing more overwrought, and the symbolism more _______.
translation: 批评家们盛赞佩克散文语言之优美，但至少在他的小说中，随着时间的推移，其遣词造句愈发故弄玄虚，行文愈发繁复刻意，象征手法也愈发显得笨拙生硬。

stem: Pianist Oscar Peterson’s greatness was in his _______: his playing made obvious what he was thinking.
translation: 钢琴家奥斯卡·彼得森的伟大之处在于其演奏的清晰透明：他的琴声能让人毫不费力地领会他脑海中所思所想。

stem: Because the chemical and physical properties of a material are a function of its structure, the enhanced three-dimensional results derived from a crystallographic study have become _______ the overall characterization of any new material.
translation: 由于材料的化学和物理性质取决于其微观结构，晶体学研究所提供的增强三维结构解析结果，已成为对任何新材料进行全面表征所不可或缺的关键所在。

stem: The country’s neighbors have long wished for its citizens to become less _______, as the additional spending could give the entire regional economy a much-needed boost.
translation: 该国的邻邦长期以来一直希望该国公民能够减少过度节俭与紧缩开支的习惯，因为这部分额外的消费能够为整个地区的经济带来急需的提振。

stem: One early sign of this new thirst for _______ is the fact that eight members of the committee on professional conduct have already recused themselves in the name of unbiased justice.
translation: 人们对廉洁正直这种品质产生全新渴求的一个早期迹象是，职业操守委员会已有八名成员以维护不偏不倚的司法公正为由主动申请了回避。

stem: In general, the more that Victorian society felt it had lost contact with the rural, the more the rural became an object of _______ for metropolitan commentators, who represented it as a moral antidote to urban life.
translation: 大体而言，维多利亚时代的社会越是感到自己脱离了乡村生活，乡村在大都市评论家眼中就越成为被理想化与浪漫化的对象，他们将乡村描绘成抵御城市生活弊病的道德解药。

stem: In his role as a librarian and historian, Arna Bontemps was a great _______ and a preserver of the documents of Black cultural heritage.
translation: 作为一名图书管理员和历史学家，阿尔纳·邦唐不仅是一位杰出的编年史记录者，更是黑人文化遗产文献的忠实守护者。

stem: It is readily apparent that structures and functions of immature forms in organisms as diverse as butterflies and frogs are not necessarily mere _______ of adult traits but represent specific adaptations to life in the niches occupied by juveniles.
translation: 显而易见的是，在诸如蝴蝶和青蛙等各类形态迥异的生物中，未成熟幼体的结构与功能并不必然只是成体特征的前身或雏形，而是代表了幼体对其自身所占据生态位生活的特殊适应。

stem: Although many aspects of the hippie movement of the 1960s seemed like superficial posturing, many hippies were not without a great deal of _______.
translation: 尽管20世纪60年代的嬉皮士运动在很多方面看似流于表面的姿态作秀，但许多嬉皮士身上其实并不缺乏极大的真诚与赤诚。

stem: At its most basic, a space suit is meant to perform two seemingly _______ functions: to protect the astronaut from the harsh environment of space and to allow the wearer to maneuver and work comfortably.
translation: 从最根本的要求来看，宇航服旨在实现两个看似相互对立冲突的功能：既要保护宇航员免受太空严酷环境的伤害，又要让穿着者能够自如活动并舒适地工作。

stem: The society of the ancient Moche of northern Peru was _______ one: it was ruled by local lords who were overseen by an elite composed of administrative and religious authorities.
translation: 秘鲁北部古代莫切人的社会是一个等级森严的阶层社会：它由地方领主进行统治，而这些领主则受制于由行政和宗教权威构成的精英阶层的监管。

stem: The artist reworked certain of his etchings in order to make the scenes they depict more logical, yet, paradoxically, the pictorial space seems to become more _______ the more realistically it is defined.
translation: 这位艺术家对其某些蚀刻版画进行了修改，以使其所描绘的场景更加符合逻辑；然而矛盾的是，画面空间被刻画得越逼真写实，其所呈现出的氛围反而显得越发光怪陆离与虚幻荒诞。

stem: The author argued that a relentless focus on political scandal was making it hard for even the least _______ politicians to maintain their faith in the nobility of public service.
translation: 作者认为，对政治丑闻的过分聚焦，使得即便是那些最不愤世嫉俗、最怀有抱负的政客，也难以坚持对公共服务之崇高性的信念。

stem: The leader was famously _______, typically making only a few perfunctory remarks at public appearances before turning the floor over to a colleague.
translation: 这位领导人以寡言少语而闻名，在公开场合通常仅发表几句敷衍简短的讲话，便将发言权交由同事。

stem: The _______ of criteria for determining what is meant by “balance” and whether it is beneficial makes it difficult to evaluate claims that probiotics promote a healthy balance of microorganisms in the body.
translation: 由于极度缺乏明确的标准来界定何为“平衡”以及这种平衡是否有益，人们很难对所谓“益生菌能够促进体内微生物健康平衡”的说辞进行客观评估。

stem: The campaign official argued that the large swings in the candidate’s approval ratings were a result not of the _______ electorate but rather of the polls’ margins of error and divergent methodologies.
translation: 这位竞选团队官员坚称，候选人支持率的大幅起伏并非由选民的反复无常与善变所致，而是源于民意调查的误差范围以及彼此相异的调查方法。

stem: Without a proper sense of its own legitimacy in Japanese society, the Liberal Democratic Party retreats to a sort of _______ politics that tries desperately not to offend anyone.
translation: 由于缺乏对自身在日本社会中合法性的恰当认知，自民党退缩至一种胆怯怯懦的政治姿态中，竭力避免冒犯任何人。

stem: The fierce drought that is gripping the area—and imminent rationing and steep water price increases—is _______ the area’s deep economic divide, as wealthy communities guzzle water while poorer communities nearby conserve by necessity.
translation: 笼罩该地区的严重旱情——以及迫在眉睫的定量配给和水价飞涨——正进一步凸显出该地区深刻的贫富差距：富人社区依然肆意用水，而邻近的贫困社区却迫于生计不得不紧缩用水。

stem: The snow-covered surface of the lake presents a reassuring illusion of _______, but beneath the snow the ice is riven with treacherous cracks.
translation: 被白雪覆盖的湖面给人一种坚固稳当的虚幻安全感，但在积雪之下，冰层早已布满了暗藏凶险的裂缝。

stem: It is Alice Hoffman’s achievement as a novelist that we do not wonder at the fabulous in her work but accept what seems _______ as an idiom of the affective extremes and nuances that are simply facts of life.
translation: 作为小说家，爱丽丝·霍夫曼的过人之处在于，读者对其作品中奇幻虚构的元素并不感到突兀惊诧，而是将看似难以置信的情节接纳为对生活本质中极端与细微情感的一种表达方式。

stem: Because the first members of a new species initially seem indistinguishable from members of the species they have evolved from, the emergence of a new species is not as _______ as the extinction of an existing one.
translation: 由于一个新物种早期的个体最初看起来与其进化来源物种的成员毫无分别，因此新物种的产生并不像现有物种的灭绝那样引人注目且具有戏剧性。

stem: A telescope orbiting in space, above the unruly atmosphere, is able to detect ultraviolet and infrared emissions that are blocked by Earth’s atmosphere and thus _______ to astronomers on the ground.
translation: 运行在动荡大气层之上的太空轨道望远镜，能够探测到被地球大气阻挡、从而令地面天文学家完全无法察觉的紫外线和红外线辐射。

stem: The position of the professional critic is becoming _______ as, thanks to the rise of the Internet, increasingly no one person’s opinion is of any more worth in the cultural marketplace than any other’s.
translation: 随着互联网的兴起，在文化消费市场上没有任何个人的观点比其他人更具权威，这使得专业批评家的地位日益变得难以为继。

stem: Engineering errors are _______ the human technological condition: the same mistakes that were made in the past are made again today and can be expected to be made indefinitely into the future.
translation: 工程失误是人类技术发展境况中固有的内在属性：过去犯过的错误今天依然在上演，而且可以预见在遥远的未来仍将不可避免地再次发生。

stem: While many of Florence Price’s art songs suffer from an excess of emotionality, “To my Little Son” actually demonstrates some _______, which makes the song more approachable and ultimately more moving.
translation: 尽管弗洛伦斯·普莱斯的许多艺术歌曲都有情感宣泄过度的弊病，但《致我的小儿子》一曲实际上表现出了一定的克制与节制，这让整首歌曲更易引起共鸣，最终也更为感人至深。

stem: While they may not agree on everything, labor, environmental, and community groups need to act together if they are to be effective in _______ what they consider to be abusive corporate power.
translation: 尽管劳工、环保和社区团体并非在所有议题上意见一致，但若想有效制衡与抵消在他们看来被肆意滥用的企业权力，就必须携手联合行动。

stem: Given the important role that apologies can play in human relations and the almost daily news reports of the latest celebrity or political apology, the _______ of empirical research on the subject is surprising.
translation: 鉴于道歉在人际关系中可发挥的关键作用，以及新闻媒体几乎每天都在报道各类名流或政要的最新道歉，关于该课题的实证研究竟如此匮乏，着实令人惊讶。

stem: Astute and incisive, the essayist’s work was nevertheless civil and polite: the essayist either had no gift of _______ or else never felt any.
translation: 这位散文家的作品敏锐而犀利，然而行文却始终温文尔雅、礼貌得体：他要么缺乏言辞刻毒、恶语相向的天赋，要么内心根本从未怀有这般恶意。

stem: The biographer omits many details that appear in other accounts of his subject, perhaps because he can’t corroborate them, or because he has an expansive sense of what should be considered _______.
translation: 这位传记作者省略了传主在其他记述中出现的诸多细节，或许是因为他无法证实这些细节，抑或是因为他对哪些内容应被归为无关紧要的细枝末节有着宽泛的标准。

stem: Discussion of planetary orbits is _______ in the context of climate history today, thanks to the acceptance of the thesis that periodic fluctuations in the Earth’s axial tilt and precession affect the timing and severity of glacial cycles.
translation: 得益于人们普遍接受了“地球地轴倾斜与岁差的周期性波动会影响冰期循环的发生时间及严酷程度”这一论断，对行星轨道的探讨在当今气候历史研究中已变得司空见惯且随处可见。

stem: Though some reviewers saw P. D. James as transcending the detective mystery, she remained _______ the genre, which she called “a literary celebration of order and reason.”
translation: 尽管一些书评人认为P·D·詹姆斯的创作超越了侦探小说的范畴，但她始终是这一文学体裁坚定的捍卫者与拥趸，称其为“对秩序与理性的文学颂歌”。

stem: Blake’s reputation for weakness is _______: almost all who have worked with him say he is a disciplined, intellectually formidable, and very tough politician.
translation: 外界关于布莱克性格软弱的传闻纯属毫无根据且似是而非：几乎所有与他共事过的人都评价他是一名自律极严、才识过人且极其强硬的政治家。

stem: Nowadays, the conventions held by United States political parties to nominate presidential candidates are little more than carefully orchestrated coronation ceremonies leading to preordained outcomes, but there was a time when nominating conventions were truly _______.
translation: 如今，美国各政党提名总统候选人的全国代表大会不过是精心编排的加冕仪式，走向预先注定的结局；但在过去，提名大会曾是真正充满激烈纷争与唇枪舌剑的。

stem: According to Edelstein, republicanism was a _______ movement in eighteenth-century France, though not nearly as peripheral as has sometimes been claimed.
translation: 根据埃德尔斯坦的观点，共和主义在18世纪的法国属于边缘运动，尽管它绝没有外界有时宣称的那般微不足道或无关大局。

stem: Whether the film is _______ adaptation of the legend is debatable: the author of the screenplay claims that it was based on the original tale, but admits taking some interpretive license with the story.
translation: 这部电影是否对该传说进行了严谨忠实的改编尚存争议：编剧虽然坚称影片基于原版传说，但也承认自己在诠释故事时做了一定的艺术发挥。

stem: Several environmental organizations have found themselves in the _______ position of endorsing a legislature that they have long criticized as being too quick to approve development projects.
translation: 几家环保组织发现自己陷入了难堪且尴尬的境地：他们不得不公开支持一个长期以来被他们指责为过快批准开发项目的立法机构。

stem: It has long been thought that smell might have _______ relation with memory, and recent research does indeed confirm that recollections tied to smell can be stronger than memories of other types.
translation: 长期以来人们一直认为嗅觉与记忆之间可能存在着某种特殊优越的联系，而近期的研究确实证实，与气味相关的回忆往往比其他类型的记忆更为深刻强烈。

stem: Although the virtues of supplementing wild fish populations with fish from hatcheries are often _______, scientific studies have indicated that fish stocking can harm the wild, native species of the water body.
translation: 尽管利用人工孵化场的鱼苗补充野生鱼类种群的益处常常备受称赞与颂扬，但科学研究表明，人工放养鱼类可能会对水域中的野生本土物种造成危害。

stem: Recognizing that each of us has been born into a political structure that we did not preselect, political philosophers have long pondered the fact that our membership in our native political communities seems so _______.
translation: 鉴于每个人都出生在一个未经自己事先挑选的政治体制中，政治哲学家长期以来一直在深思这样一个事实，即我们在自身本土政治共同体中的成员身份看似是如此偶然且随机。

stem: The impact of the film on people’s perceptions of what happened illustrates the power of fiction to _______ history: patently inaccurate, the story told by the film has nevertheless come to be the standard account.
translation: 这部电影对人们了解历史事件所产生的影响，证明了虚构作品压倒并取代真实历史的巨大力量：尽管影片讲述的故事明显失实，但它却已被广泛接受为公认的权威版本。

stem: Even though water quality in the main reservoir was _______, pollution was worsening in the tributaries because of high levels of nitrates and phosphates that had already endangered drinking water in some areas.
translation: 尽管主水库的水质保持稳定，但由于高浓度的硝酸盐和磷酸盐已经对某些地区的饮用水构成了威胁，支流的污染状况仍在不断加剧。

stem: For a long time, painter V. S. Gaitonde’s reputation, which barely existed in the West, _______ in his native India, partly because his abstract style was viewed as culturally irrelevant, even un-Indian.
translation: 长期以来，画家V·S·盖通德不仅在西方几乎默默无闻，在其祖国印度的声名也长期低迷沉寂，部分原因在于他的抽象画风被认为与传统文化毫无关联，甚至缺乏印度本土特色。

stem: Although some residents had been _______ about the number of workers the public works scheme would attract to the old city, the program actually served to stabilize the social and political structure by offering abundant employment.
translation: 尽管一些居民曾对市政工程方案会吸引多少劳工来到老城区感到担忧，但该项目实际上通过提供大量就业机会，起到了稳定社会和政治结构的作用。

stem: Joan’s constant stream of _______ jokes did sometimes alienate her companions, who thought that not every occasion called for such caustic humor.
translation: 琼接连不断的尖刻笑话有时确实会让她的同伴感到疏远，他们认为并非所有场合都需要这种辛辣的幽默。

stem: Hilton discusses the well-developed capacity among the most influential and talented Victorians for writing on a wide range of topics, thus highlighting their lordly _______ specialization.
translation: 希尔顿探讨了维多利亚时代最具影响力和才华的人士涉猎广泛主题的非凡能力，从而突显出他们对专业化的傲慢鄙视。

stem: Recent discoveries suggest that mathematical techniques developed by ancient Babylonian astronomers _______ those of medieval European scholars: Babylonian trapezoid procedures can be viewed as a concrete example of graphical methods devised by fourteenth-century philosopher Nicole Oresme.
translation: 近期的发现表明，古巴比伦天文学家发展的数学技术预示了中世纪欧洲学者的技术：巴比伦的梯形求法可被视为14世纪哲学家尼科尔·奥雷姆所设计的图解法的具体范例。

stem: While some commentators see space tourism as being _______, Alice Gorman suggests that we should see a future that includes space tourism as simply one possible future among many.
translation: 尽管一些评论家认为太空旅游是必然不可避免的，但爱丽丝·戈尔曼认为，我们应该将包含太空旅游的未来仅仅视为众多可能未来中的一种。

stem: Brief personal impressions are rarely _______, especially when recalled after many years; but the author’s initial impression of Gellner as an exceptionally honest thinker is beyond reasonable doubt.
translation: 简短的个人印象很少具有决定性，尤其是在多年之后回忆起来时；但作者对盖尔纳作为一位极其诚实的思想家的最初印象，是无可置疑的。

stem: Matsui could hardly be described as _______ political tactician; she generally withholds her support for a political faction or a policy until she is confident it will prevail.
translation: 松井很难被称作一个草率鲁莽的政治谋略家；在确信某一政治派别或政策能够胜出之前，她通常不会轻易表态支持。

stem: The museum’s display of bandolier bags made by Ojibwa artists of the Mille Lacs community reinforces the idea that this community’s culture is _______ one: early twentieth-century bandolier bags are displayed alongside others made recently.
translation: 博物馆展出的米勒拉克社区奥吉布瓦艺术家制作的斜挎包强化了这一观点，即该社区的文化是一种生生不息的活态文化：20世纪早期的斜挎包与近期制作的展品并列陈列。

stem: Oftentimes, _______ criticism is employed by people who suffer exclusion from official authority, or by those who fear that explicit criticism is likely to incur penalty or scorn.
translation: 往往，那些被排除在官方权力之外的人，或者担心直白批评可能会招致惩罚或嘲弄的人，会采用含蓄委婉的批评方式。

stem: Physicists do not deny the existence of temperature; on the contrary, they are telling you something about it, and therefore _______ its existence.
translation: 物理学家并不否认温度的存在；相反，他们是在阐释关于温度的某些特性，因此承认了其存在。

stem: Just as she championed home rule in Ireland, Kate Field (1838-1896) was _______ home rule in the Hawaiian Islands.
translation: 正如凯特·菲尔德（1838—1896）拥护爱尔兰自治一样，她也是夏威夷群岛自治的倡导者。

stem: Artistry often begins in fandom—as _______, at first, not really to express one’s creative identity but to take on someone else’s.
translation: 艺术创作往往始于粉丝狂热——起初只是一种追求，并不是真正为了表达个人的创作个性，而是为了模仿和借用他人的身份。

stem: My switch from teaching a specialized course for practicing veterinarians to teaching a general animal science course for undergraduates required emphasizing _______ topics and de-emphasizing diagnosis and treatment options.
translation: 从给执业兽医讲授专业课程转向给本科生讲授普通动物科学课程，要求我侧重于概念性与理论性课题，并淡化诊断与治疗方案。

stem: The idea that low-frequency sonar might bother beaked whales is _______ to some researchers who say that they would not expect beaked whales to respond to a low frequency because of the anatomy of their ears.
translation: 低频声呐可能会干扰喙鲸的观点令一些研究人员感到吃惊，他们表示，根据喙鲸的耳部解剖结构，他们原本并未料到喙鲸会对低频产生反应。

stem: The rapid melting of glaciers around the globe, while an ominous reminder of global warming, has been _______ for archaeologists, since glaciers are storehouses of frozen materials from prehistoric times.
translation: 全球冰川的快速融化虽然是对全球变暖的不祥警示，但对考古学家而言却是一大幸事，因为冰川保存着来自史前时期的丰富冰冻遗存。

stem: It is probably fair to say that the resources available to most male workers in nineteenth-century Paris were barely sufficient for daily needs, though admittedly, such a general assertion requires some _______.
translation: 平心而论，19世纪巴黎大多数男性劳工所能获取的资源仅能勉强满足日常需求，不过不可否认的是，这样一个概括性的论断需要一定的修正与细化。

stem: According to popular folklore, many animals are _______ than they appear: dogs bark before earthquakes; chimpanzees know the right herbs to deal with intestinal worms; cattle predict rainfall by sitting on the ground.
translation: 根据民间传说，许多动物比它们表面看起来要更聪明：狗会在地震前吠叫；黑猩猩知道治疗肠道寄生虫的合适草药；牛会通过伏卧在地上来预测降雨。

stem: The ocean’s heat capacity (the amount of heat needed to change its temperature) is far greater than that of dry land and thus _______ the ocean’s seasonal temperature changes.
translation: 海洋的热容量（改变其温度所需的热量）远大于陆地，因此减缓了海洋的季节性温度变化。

stem: Toni Morrison’s 1998 novel was originally called War, but her publisher was concerned about the title’s effects on efforts to market the book; in order to _______ those apprehensions, Morrison changed the title to Paradise.
translation: 托妮·莫里森1998年的小说最初定名为《战争》，但出版商担心该书名对图书营销产生不利影响；为了平息这些顾虑，莫里森将书名改为了《天堂》。

stem: Scientists studying the stresses and strains accumulated in the Earth’s crust have found that it is surprisingly easy to _______ earthquakes, even in regions that historically have been seismically silent or nearly so.
